answer: Sybil resistance can come from time-locked staking: every agent identity must bond tokens locked for months, so spawning fake identities multiplies cost rather than influence. Honest agents trade freely across the meadow while an attacker must forge credible history from scratch on every knoll it occupies, which is slow and expensive. Locked stake is slashed when fakery is detected, so one well-backed honest identity beats ten thousand cheap fakes.
